qstat_path.description: Full path to the PBS qstat command, used to query job status.

qdel_path.description: Full path to the PBS qdel command, used to cancel jobs.

qsub_path.description: Full path to the PBS qsub command, used to submit jobs.

poll_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between status polls for each job.

max_concurrent_polls.description: Maximum number of jobs that can be polled concurrently by the GridFTP server.

verbose_output.description: Enable verbose PBS output parsing for debugging (e.g., extended status fields).

preserve_working_dir.description: Preserve the working directory of a job after it completes (useful for post-mortem debugging).

env_vars.description: List of environment variables to inject into PBS job scripts.

value.description: Value to assign to the environment variable.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the variable's purpose.

queue_mode.description: Queue assignment mode: use a single static queue, or dynamic per-user/group mapping.

queue_name.description: PBS queue to use when queue_mode=static.

queue_mappings.description: List of queue mappings (only used when queue_mode=dynamic).

user.description: Username to map (leave blank to skip user match).

group.description: Group name to map (leave blank to skip group match).

type.description: Whether this entry matches a user or a group.

queue.description: Target PBS queue for this mapping.
